headline: Nicușor Dan, after Standard & Poor's verdict: This is not a moment to relax
summary: Rating agency Standard & Poor's placed Romania on the lowest step of investment grade, avoiding a downgrade to junk. President Nicușor Dan said it was not a moment to relax.
why: Sovereign credit ratings determine borrowing costs and eligibility for many institutional bond portfolios. A junk downgrade would be a major risk for Romanian government debt.
